description: Operator-directed slot move, single new variable on top of the declared bundle state: move the PM8533 upstream from its current slot (PCH root port 00:1d.0 path) to a DIFFERENT PCH x1 slot (operator-selected target; tests the operator hypothesis that the chronic RxErr source is the specific slot/bus path - if the flood follows the card it is card/adapter-side, if it vanishes it was the slot path). Cold power cycle after the move. Expected post-move: switch upstream enumerates at a NEW BDF on a different root port; chain re-derivation is by PM8533 identity + bus chaining (fresh bytes only).
